testPlan.title: Settings page fits, launch button stays on screen (issue 28)

test.title: The game loaded this test version
test.hint: This ticks by itself. Nothing to do.

test.title: Make the editor big
test.hint: Open the editor settings (more settings...). Set ui scale to 1.5 x or more. Then click PASS.

test.title: The settings page fits
test.hint: The title and the close button can both be reached. The page is not cut off top or bottom. PASS if so.

test.title: The wheel scrolls the page
test.hint: Roll the wheel over the rows. The page should move and a bar on the right should show where you are. No value should change. PASS if so.

test.title: The - and + buttons still work
test.hint: Scroll down to LAUNCH BUTTON. Use + on position. It should change. Set ui scale back to 1.0 x. PASS if all fine.

test.title: Small page: wheel still changes values
test.hint: At 1.0 x the page fits. Roll the wheel over a value: it should change, as before. PASS if so.

test.title: Button set to right stays on screen
test.hint: Set position to right. Close the editor. With AutoDrive's box at the right edge, the button should sit on its left, fully on screen. PASS if so.

test.title: Above and below stay on screen
test.hint: Try above and below too. Drag AutoDrive's box near the top or bottom edge. The button should never go off screen. Set it back the way you like it, then PASS.
